candidates.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Codex Security

Codex Security helps you find, investigate, and fix vulnerabilities in your code.
Use its security workflows in Codex, or automate them with the
`@openai/codex-security` CLI and TypeScript SDK.

- **In Codex:** [choose a security workflow](docs/agent-workflows.md).
- **In a terminal:** [install the CLI and scan your repository](#quick-start).
- **In automation:** use the [TypeScript SDK](#typescript-sdk) or
  [GitHub Action](#github-actions).

## Features

- Scan repositories, selected paths, or Git changes. Deep scans repeat Standard scans and return their deduplicated findings.
- Validate candidate findings, generate patches, and verify existing fixes.
- Draft `SECURITY.md` policies and save threat models for later review.
- Browse saved scans and findings, identify duplicates, assess severity against
  your own rubric, and suggest owners from source and Git history.
- Preview third-party scanner findings, save them locally, or publish supported reports to Codex Security Cloud. [Scanner import guides](docs/scanner-imports/README.md).
- Track findings in Linear, Jira, or GitHub, publish completed scans, or export SARIF, JSON, and CSV. [Integration workflows](docs/plugin-connectors.md).
- Automate scans across repositories or project components, including in CI and
  containers.

## Use in Codex

Open your repository in a Codex session with the Codex Security plugin enabled,
then ask:

> Run a Codex Security scan on this repository, focusing on authentication and
> authorization. Return the saved report, source evidence, and coverage limits.

A completed scan saves a report and findings. Read the report for source
evidence and exclusions, then request a patch or ask Codex to verify an
existing fix. See the [agent workflow guide](docs/agent-workflows.md) for setup,
task selection, and recovery.

## Quick start

Requires Node.js 22.13.0+ within 22.x, or Node.js 24.x or 26.x, and Python 3.10+.
Python 3.10 also requires `tomli`.

Install the CLI globally and sign in:

```bash
npm install --global @openai/codex-security
cs login
```

Run your first scan from the repository directory:

```bash
cs scan .
```

When the scan completes, open the Markdown file at the **REPORT** path in the
terminal. Run `cs scans show` from the same repository to find its latest
completed scan again. See [scan scope and follow-up work](sdk/typescript/docs/cli.md#understand-scan-scope-and-follow-up-work)
for how to interpret exclusions in the report.

candidates.description: Inference code for Haas, fast and accurate Japanese speech recognition
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Haas-ASR

🤗 Model  |  📑 Blog  |  📊 Benchmark  |  📏 jacer

Inference code for the **Haas** speech recognition models. The first release, **Haas-ja-v1.0**, is a Japanese model: a FastConformer encoder with a TDT decoder whose prediction network uses Kimi Delta Attention. ![Haas-ja-v1.0 architecture](assets/architecture.png) ## Results On [asr-ja-bench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/third-intelligence/asr-ja-bench) v1.1, five public Japanese test sets, Haas-ja-v1.0 reaches a weighted CER strict of 6.12%, the best of the open models we evaluated. It is competitive with commercial APIs: on par with GPT-Transcribe (6.07%), while MAI-Transcribe 2, Scribe v2 and Gemini 3.1 Pro remain more accurate. In each cell, the top value is CER strict and the bottom values are CER flex / kana (%, lower is better): ![CER of each model on the five datasets and RTFx](assets/cer_table.png) Among open models, Haas-ja-v1.0 is on the Pareto frontier of speed and accuracy. It runs at almost the same speed as Parakeet (RTFx 3,236 vs. 3,407) while cutting CER strict by about 1.1 points, and is about 15–17 times faster than Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Whisper large-v3, the next most accurate open models. ![CER strict against RTFx / Speed Factor for all models](assets/cer_vs_rtfx.png) It transcribes an hour of audio for about $0.003–0.004, roughly 1/70–1/100 of GPT-Transcribe, which has similar accuracy. ![CER strict against inference cost per hour of audio](assets/cer_vs_cost.png) For the evaluation details, including the benchmark design, the CER metrics and the full results, see the [blog post](https://third-intelligence.com/ja/posts/haas-ja-v1-release). [Evaluation](#evaluation) below shows how to reproduce the Haas-ja-v1.0 results. ## Requirements - Linux with an NVIDIA GPU. The decoder's attention kernels come from [flash-linear-attention](https://github.com/fla-org/flash-linear-attention), which needs Triton and CUDA, so CPU and macOS are not supported. - Python 3.11+, NeMo 2.7. - The speaker-label example has its own environment, with Python 3.12 and a newer NeMo. It is created in `examples/speakers/`

candidates.description: Offline AI narration studio for Android: turn scripts into natural speech and clone your voice, all on-device. No cloud, no account.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Hush Studio

Hush Studio is an Android app that turns written scripts into natural-sounding speech, entirely on the phone. You can narrate with one of six built-in voices or clone your own voice from a short recording. After a one-time model download, nothing is sent over the network: scripts, recordings and generated audio stay on the device.

It is built for long-form narration such as video voiceovers, audiobook drafts and podcasts, rather than instant one-line text-to-speech.

## Features

- **Offline speech generation** using the VoxCPM 0.5B model, running on the phone's CPU.
- **Voice cloning** from 5 to 10 seconds of speech. You can record or import audio in any format the phone can decode. The app picks a clean section and writes the transcript offline. A cloned voice is saved as a reusable reference; no model is retrained.
- **Six built-in voices** made from openly licensed recordings (see [Credits](#credits)).
- **Chunk studio.** Each paragraph becomes its own chunk. You can generate, play, edit or regenerate any chunk without touching the others, and earlier takes are kept.
- **Export** a full narration as a 16 kHz mono WAV file.
- **Library** of projects with search, rename and delete. Unfinished projects are kept, so you can come back to them.
- Light and dark appearance that follows the system setting.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Android | 9 or later (API 28+) |
| CPU | 64-bit ARM (arm64-v8a). Phones with ARMv8.2 dot-product and FP16 support (most from 2019 onward) use a faster engine; older 64-bit phones run a compatible engine automatically. |
| Memory | 4 GB RAM minimum; 6 GB recommended. Generation peaks at about 1.7 GB. |
| Storage | About 650 MB free for the speech model, plus space for projects |
| Network | Needed once, to download the 500 MB speech model |

## Installation

1. Download the latest APK from the [Releases](../../releases) page and install it. Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager.
2. Open the app and go to **Settings > Speech Model** to download the model, or import the `voxcpm-0.5b-q4_k.gguf` file if you already have it. The file is checked against a fixed SHA-256 hash before use.
3. Write or paste a script in **Create**, choose a voice and tap **Generate**.

## what's cap? cap is a self-hosted and privacy-first captcha alternative that doesn't force your users to click on traffic lights. there are no puzzles, no tracking, and no third parties watching your visitors. instead, the user's browser quietly solves a few small challenges in the background, such as gpu-resistant proof-of-work and instrumentation, which can also be configured to stop autonomous AI agents from using up your resources. it has no dependencies by default, is 200x smaller than hCaptcha, and you can run it with docker, on workers or on railway. it's already used in production by large companies like [bunny.net](https://bunny.net) and [adguard](https://adguard.com). ### license cap is licensed under [apache 2.0](LICENSE).

# OpenGMB OpenGMB manages Google Business Profiles for local businesses and the agencies that run them. Reviews, review replies, posts, profile edits, performance, reports and Maps rank tracking, for every location, in one place. Two things make it different. Every reply, post and profile edit passes a set of rules and waits for a person to approve it before Google sees it. And every action in the app is also an MCP tool, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can do the routine work while you keep the final say. This repository is the **community edition**: MIT licensed, self-hosted with Docker Compose, your own keys, one owner login for as many clients and locations as you need. It talks to Google only through the official Business Profile API.

Omnigent is an open-source **meta-harness** that gives you a common orchestration layer over Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Goose, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Kiro, Qwen Code, Kimi Code, Grok Build, Jcode, Hermes, Pi, OpenAI Agents / Open Responses, and the agents you write yourself: swap or combine harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device — terminal, browser, phone, or the native desktop app. [![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/omnigent.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/omnigent/) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/omnigent) ![Status: alpha](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-alpha-orange.svg) [omnigent.ai](https://omnigent.ai) · **[⬇️ Download the macOS desktop app](https://omnigent.ai/quickstart/install#install-the-desktop-app)**

ToolJet is an open-source platform for building internal tools: admin panels, dashboards, and operational apps that run on your existing databases, APIs, and SaaS systems. Build them by prompting. ToolJet AI turns a description into pages, queries, and components, and the coding agent you already use can do the same through ToolJet's MCP server. Ekko Studio 中文

A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for
Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex.
Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

Download Ekko Studio Desktop · Documentation · npm install -g ekko-studio && ekko-studio-web start

Ekko Studio was previously named Hermes Studio / Hermes Web UI. The GitHub repository is `EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio`. The primary npm package is `ekko-studio`, with the `ekko-studio-web` command. The legacy `hermes-web-ui` package and command remain supported and receive the same releases. ## Screenshots Captured from **v0.8.13** source on 2026-11-03, running locally with isolated data.
